title: Fake
text:
Fake. I have severe allergies and asthma. I was looking for something for our small house.

My parents have one that works great. This is not the same. It does nothing and it was an overall disappointment. The only filtering that happened was it gathered dust. If you are looking for something that takes up space and cost more that it should this is for you.

It never had the smell, sounds etc that the genuine one my parents have does. It went to the scrap pile.

I never reviewed this to my knowledge before. I came across it while searching for the filter replacements for the one I finally got that works. Save your money and invest in a good filtration system especially if you have respiratory problems, for a bit more you can have one that actually does more that move a bit of air around. I went with a medify brand and it works very well. You will have to buy filters however.

product_metadata.title: Envion Ionic Pro 90IP01TA01W Turbo Ionic Air Purifier, 500 sq ft Room Capacity, Black
features: Ultra-quiet air purifier reduces airborne microorganisms and odors from your home and discharges invigorated air without emitting ambient noise
Made for medium rooms with a 3-speed fan for desired cleaning level and up to 3 cleans in 1 hour
Ionic technology uses negative ions to attract positive airborne pollutants and particles in the air; Traps pollen, dust, smoke, and pet dander down to 0.1 microns
Easy-to-clean front-loading filter limits the frequency of costly replacements
Sophisticated tower design uses less energy than a compact fluorescent bulb
description: With more and more germs and air irritants affecting day-to-day life, make sure your own home isn't subject to the same conditions. With the Ionic Pro Turbo Air Purifier from ENVION, your space will be free from air pollutants that can be dangerous to your health. Made for medium to large rooms, this air cleaner can purify up to 500 square feet 3 times in 1 hour. The 3-speed fan lets you decide what cleaning level is most desirable. With ionic purification, this air purifier captures pollutants. In combination with UV light, this irritant remover expertly reduces certain viruses and bacteria. This sophisticated tower uses less energy than a compact fluorescent bulb. With an easy-to-clean filter, you can limit the frequency of costly filter replacements, saving money. Say goodbye to airborne germs and odors and discharge invigorated, clean air without emitting any ambient noise. Don't overlook the impact your home's air quality has on your well-being. Improve your health and the health of those around you with the ENVION Ionic Pro Turbo Air Purifier.
